verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, Cursor AI) that add Connector SDK skills allowing users to 'build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts,' which directly supports AI-drafted custom connectors that a human can review and ship. However, this is vendor-only documentation with no example showing the AI specifically handling auth, pagination, and streams from raw API docs, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of success rates.  missing for 10: concrete example/demo of AI generating auth+pagination+stream logic from arbitrary API docs, independent or hands-on verification of connector quality, detail on the review/ship workflow.
